readout_other: von Frey fibres; Randall-Selitto test; hot plate test; H&E histology of L5 DRG
direction_notes: HIFU to the L5 DRG raised mechanical and thermal thresholds in vincristine-induced neuropathy rats at 24 and 48 h versus sham; thresholds were unchanged in naive rats.
safety_notes: Histology showed transient cellular swelling that largely resolved by 24-48 h and intact ganglion cells at 5 d; no obvious motor dysfunction for 7 d.

exposures.label: Pulsed HIFU to left L5 DRG

timing.protocol_description: Pulsed HIFU delivered with the probe touching the DRG, 'frequency of 38 Hz, pulse width of 90 us, and amplitude of 3 W for 3 min'; acoustic output power of 3 W stated to produce a power density of 2.05 W/cm2. A 2 min dose was ineffective in a preliminary experiment.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A total of 23 rats were compared: 7 VIN HIFU rats at 3 W for 3 min, 7 VIN sham HIFU, 5 naïve HIFU at 3 W for 3 min, and 4 VIN only rats
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: it was administered at a frequency of 38 Hz, pulse width of 90 μss, and amplitude of 3 W for 3 min

source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: using an interstitial HIFU device (Acoustic MedSystems Inc, Savoy, Illinois)
source_quotes.sham_type: VIN underwent DRG exposure surgery but received no HIFU application
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: They found that 1-time unilateral focal sonication of the L5 dorsal root ganglion (DRG) resulted in increased sensory and thermal thresholds for up to 48 hours after treatment.

flags.reason: The paper gives only 'a frequency of 38 Hz'; the acoustic carrier frequency is never stated
38 Hz is called the frequency of administration; interpreted as PRF but the paper does not say so
Text reads 'pulse width of 90 us' with OCR 'μss'; 90 us converted to 0.09 ms
Power density of 2.05 W/cm2 is stated for 3 W output without saying which intensity metric or domain; not placed in a field
23 rats compared includes 7 sham and 4 VIN-only; HIFU-exposed groups listed as [7, 5]; a further 8 VIN HIFU rats were used in the preliminary 2 min experiment
Sham rats underwent DRG exposure surgery without HIFU; mechanism not in the vocabulary, recorded as other
